# Vendored terminal assets

Unmodified npm assets, bundled for offline builds and runtime use.
MIT licenses: [xterm](LICENSE-xterm), [addon-fit](LICENSE-addon-fit).

| File | Package | Version | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `xterm.js`, `xterm.css` | `@xterm/xterm` | 6.0.0 | `lib/xterm.js`, `css/xterm.css` |
| `addon-fit.js` | `@xterm/addon-fit` | 0.11.0 | `lib/addon-fit.js` |

UMD bundles: globals `Terminal` and `FitAddon.FitAddon`. To update, fetch the new tarballs, replace the files and bump the versions here.
